summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.82/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.82 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 27, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ higher than a week ago, 21¢ higher than a month ago, and 98¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.58) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.99).
